study: Daml authorization, obligation formation and scoped delegation
scope: documentation and formal-rule analysis; no runtime/source implementation attestation

claims.claim: Formal required authorizers are create signatories or exercise/fetch actors. Root context is commit requesters; a consequence context is the immediate parent exercise actors plus input-contract signatories, not all ancestor authority.

claims.claim: Authorization and conformance are distinct: relabeling an unauthorized asset transfer actor to an available authorizer can satisfy the former while violating the template controller rule.
